c.v: The ESP32-S3 adds a series of extended instruction set in order to improve the operation efficiency of specific AI and DSP (Digital Signal Processing) algorithms.
This instruction set is designed from the TIE (Tensilica Instruction Extension) language, and adds general-purpose registers with large bit width, various special registers and processor ports.
Based on the SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data) concept, this instruction set supports
vector operations, which greatly increases data operation efficiency.

In addition, the arithmetic instructions, such as multiplication, shifting, and accumulation, can perform data operations and transfer data at the same time, thus further increasing execution efficiency of a single instruction.
